def_en: A device that connects your network to the Internet and sends data to the right place.
example_en: The router is in the server room.
example_es: El router está en la sala de servidores.

def_en: A device that connects several computers in a local network.
example_en: Plug each cable into the switch.
example_es: Conecta cada cable al conmutador.

def_en: A device that connects you to the Internet through a phone or cable line.
example_en: Restart the modem and wait one minute.
example_es: Reinicia el módem y espera un minuto.

def_en: A device that gives Wi-Fi to the computers near it.
example_en: We installed a new access point on the ceiling.
example_es: Instalamos un punto de acceso nuevo en el techo.

def_en: A card that lets a computer connect to a network.
example_en: The network card is damaged.
example_es: La tarjeta de red está estropeada.

def_en: A cable with RJ45 connectors used for wired networks.
example_en: An Ethernet cable is more stable than Wi-Fi.
example_es: Un cable Ethernet es más estable que el wifi.

def_en: The plastic plug at the end of an Ethernet cable.
example_en: Crimp the RJ45 connector onto the cable.
example_es: Crimpa el conector RJ45 en el cable.

def_en: A technology that connects devices to a network without cables.
example_en: The Wi-Fi is slow in this room.
example_es: El wifi va lento en esta sala.

def_en: A network that connects computers in a small area, such as an office.
example_en: The LAN connects all the computers in the building.
example_es: La red local conecta todos los ordenadores del edificio.

def_en: A network that covers a large area, such as a country.
example_en: The Internet is the biggest WAN in the world.
example_es: Internet es la WAN más grande del mundo.

def_en: A number that identifies a device in a network.
example_en: Every computer in the network has a different IP address.
example_es: Cada ordenador de la red tiene una dirección IP distinta.

def_en: The amount of data that a connection can carry at the same time.
example_en: Video calls need a lot of bandwidth.
example_es: Las videollamadas necesitan mucho ancho de banda.

def_en: A set of rules that computers follow to communicate.
example_en: HTTP is a protocol used by web browsers.
example_es: HTTP es un protocolo que usan los navegadores web.

def_en: A security system that blocks dangerous traffic from the network.
example_en: The firewall blocks unknown connections.
example_es: El cortafuegos bloquea las conexiones desconocidas.

def_en: A person who manages and protects a company network.
example_en: The network administrator creates new user accounts.
example_es: El administrador de redes crea cuentas de usuario nuevas.

def_en: A folder that several users can open over the network.
example_en: Save the report in the shared folder.
example_es: Guarda el informe en la carpeta compartida.

def_en: A server that stores files for all the users.
example_en: The file server is full.
example_es: El servidor de archivos está lleno.

def_en: A server that stores websites and sends them to browsers.
example_en: The web server is down.
example_es: El servidor web está caído.

def_en: A server that sends and receives emails.
example_en: The mail server needs more space.
example_es: El servidor de correo necesita más espacio.

def_en: A problem that stops the network from working.
example_en: A network failure stopped the office for two hours.
example_es: Un fallo de red paralizó la oficina durante dos horas.

def_en: An Internet or network connection that has low speed.
example_en: A slow connection makes video calls difficult.
example_es: Una conexión lenta hace difíciles las videollamadas.

def_en: Your personal access to a computer or system, with a name and password.
example_en: I created a user account for the new employee.
example_es: He creado una cuenta de usuario para el nuevo empleado.

def_en: The movement of information from one device to another.
example_en: Data transfer is faster with a cable.
example_es: La transferencia de datos es más rápida con cable.

def_en: Using a computer from another place through the network.
example_en: Remote access lets me work from home.
example_es: El acceso remoto me permite trabajar desde casa.
